lines.text: @maya_front dives off a wooden jetty into a still lake, and the ripples spread to the far shore.
Hold on the ripples after she is gone.

new_beats.text: Some days start with a single leap.

writes.note: I added a short VO beat that a narrator says over the dive and the ripples.

reply.rationale: The words stay as they were; one short VO line sits over the dive and lets the ripples hold in silence afterwards.
